title: Bytefield .edn raw parse instance
description: The output shape of bin/parse_bytefield_edn.py for one .edn source. Written against the real output of all 29 packet diagrams in src/images/packet/ (2026-10-13), not designed up front -- see bin/validate_bytefield_instances.py for the iteration that produced this.

source.description: Path to the .edn file this instance was parsed from.

defs.description: Top-level (def NAME VALUE) bindings -- layout constants, not packet-structure facts.

attrs_registry.description: Resolved (defattrs :name ...) definitions, keyed by name without the leading ':'.

items.description: The flat, in-source-order sequence of draw-box/draw-gap calls (the boilerplate bit-index header row and draw-bottom are not items -- see the module docstring).

warnings.description: Non-fatal parse notes (e.g. an attrs keyword with no local defattrs -- a bytefield-svg library built-in like :bold, kept opaque rather than guessed).

attrs.description: A flattened, resolved attrs map. defattrs doesn't distinguish box-styling attrs (span/fill/text-anchor -- used as a draw-box/draw-gap attrs argument) from text/font-styling attrs (font-family/font-size/font-style/white-space -- used only as a (text ...) span-style selector, never directly as a box attrs argument in practice), so attrs_registry entries may be either shape; this covers both as one permissive superset rather than modeling them as two schemas for one Clojure-level concept.

span.description: Width of this box in boxes-per-row units -- the one field with real packet-structure meaning. Absent means the implicit default (1 unit).

fill.description: Presentation only (e.g. '#eeeeee' for an optional/variable-length field, '#dddddd' for a field-group header row -- a real but not-yet-formalized structural signal, see the design-sketch memory).

_keyword.description: An attrs keyword with no local defattrs definition -- a bytefield-svg library built-in (e.g. 'bold'), kept as an opaque tag rather than resolved.

style.description: The defattrs name the annotation span was rendered in, e.g. 'cursive' -- in practice always the conditional/arithmetic qualifier text, e.g. '(AM=F+1 or F) - only present when MAM flag is set'.

kind.description: 'gap' marks a variable-length field (e.g. Client Identifier, Will Payload) with no fixed span; 'box' is everything else, fixed- or default-width.

label.description: The field's plain-text name. May be empty ('') for a pure spacer/alignment box, or a bare bit value ('0'/'X') inside a bit-breakdown row.

attrs_keywords.description: The raw :keyword name(s) referenced at this call site, before flattening -- the stable signal for semantic classification (e.g. 'bg-mediumgray' means group-header, 'bg-lightgray' means optional/variable), independent of whatever CSS fill color that name happens to resolve to today.
